scripts.dev:scraper: cd apps/scraper && uv run uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:bot: cd apps/bot && uv run python main.py
scripts.setup: pnpm run setup:shared-models && pnpm run setup:scraper && pnpm run setup:bot && pnpm install
scripts.setup:scraper: cd apps/scraper && uv venv && uv pip install -e ../../packages/shared-models && uv sync
scripts.setup:bot: cd apps/bot && uv venv && uv pip install -e ../../packages/shared-models && uv sync
